services.desc: Adventurers, party of four! Rent a pedal boat and explore the calm waters of Nottingham Lake. Maybe you want to give your legs a break after a Vail Valley hike or maybe you just want to take it easy - we’re just glad you’re here with us to have some fun while taking in beautiful views near Beaver Creek. services.name: Single Kayak
services.desc: All or part of this operation is conducted on Public Lands under special permit from the U.S. Bureau of Land Management. Lake Dillon rewards paddlers who trade a solo rental for a synchronized crew. An outrigger turns mountain water into a guided team adventure grounded in Polynesian paddling traditions. Outrigger canoe Colorado adventures at Lake Dillon pair a guided cultural tour with stable, multi-person paddling on high-alpine water, framed by mountain views and fresh air. Unlike a solo paddleboard or kayak rental, each crew learns together, follows an experienced guide, and shares the work of moving the canoe across open water. services.name: SUP
services.desc: All or part of this operation is conducted on Public Lands under special permit from the U.S. Bureau of Land Management. The easiest way to choose between Lake Dillon kayak rentals and paddle board rentals is to start with your group, not the gear. If you want seated stability, easier conversation, and a calmer first outing, book a kayak. If you want a more active balance challenge with big mountain views, book a paddle board. Ready to get on the water? Reserve Lake Dillon kayak rentals or paddle board rentals with Stand Up Paddle Colorado before your visit. Stand Up Paddle Colorado serves paddlers at the Dillon location on Dillon Reservoir, plus other Colorado water adventure locations
